bio.text: Adrian Smith represents Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District and was first elected to Congress in 2006.
A Gering native, he worked as an educator and real estate agent, served on the Gering city council, and represented District 48 in the Nebraska Legislature for eight years.
He has served on the House Ways and Means Committee since 2010, where he chairs the Trade Subcommittee.
He and his wife Andrea live in Gering.
